svg.title: Bulgaria’s allowance auction revenues
svg.desc: 2012–2025 reported revenue · 2026 forecast from data at 16 November 2012: weighted price 6.76 €/allowance; total allowances 3,277,000; revenue excluding aviation 22,137,930 € 2013: weighted price 4.38 €/allowance; total allowances 12,110,500; revenue excluding aviation 53,017,680 € 2014: weighted price 5.92 €/allowance; total allowances 6,151,500; revenue excluding aviation 36,192,295 € 2015: weighted price 7.62 €/allowance; total allowances 15,990,000; revenue excluding aviation 120,908,480 € 2016: weighted price 5.26 €/allowance; total allowances 16,216,000; revenue excluding aviation 85,079,960 € 2017: weighted price 5.76 €/allowance; total allowances 22,632,500; revenue excluding aviation 130,150,145 € 2018: weighted price 15.43 €/allowance; total allowances 23,868,500; revenue excluding aviation 367,342,575 € 2019: weighted price 24.61 €/allowance; total allowances 17,889,000; revenue excluding aviation 439,191,170 € 2020: weighted price 24.28 €/allowance; total allowances 18,474,000; revenue excluding aviation 447,545,340 € 2021: weighted price 53.01 €/allowance; total allowances 15,711,500; revenue excluding aviation 830,904,805 € 2022: weighted price 79.78 €/allowance; total allowances 13,716,000; revenue excluding aviation 1,091,346,540 € 2023: weighted price 83.35 €/allowance; total allowances 14,062,500; revenue excluding aviation 1,167,622,025 € 2024: weighted price 64.69 €/allowance; total allowances 12,774,500; revenue excluding aviation 822,205,680 € 2025: weighted price 73.40 €/allowance; total allowances 11,392,500; revenue excluding aviation 829,233,344 € 2026 · at 16 November: 79.47 €/allowance; 8,014,500 total allowances; installation revenue not supplied Conditional full-year forecast 2026: ≈ 720.4 € million Total · 2012–2025 (excludes 2026 forecast): 6,442,877,969 € Highest annual revenue: 2023 · 1,167,622,025 € 2025 compared with 2024: +0.9% Price and total allowances include aviation; reported historical revenue excludes aviation. 2026*: interim data at 16 Nov 2026. Separate installation revenue is not reported. 2026 forecast ≈ 79.47 × 8,014,500 × 365/320 × 99.169% = €720.4m. Assumes constant price and daily volume; 320 calendar days elapsed. Seasonality is not modeled. Installation share uses 2025 revenue: 829,233,344 / 836,182,380. Forecast excluded from historical total. 2013 includes €388,700 from an exceptional auction of remaining 2012 allowances. Source for historical receipts: MoEW.
